title: python 3.14 → 3.15: rebuild required
text: Checked 2026-10-10 23:31 UTC: 13 of 240 packages fail against python 3.15: btrfs-progs, electrum, input-remapper, libblockdev, opensnitch, python-dnspython, python-guessit, python-pyqt6, python-rebulk, refind-btrfs, samba, sonic-frameworks-core-addons, util-linux.
